# FLX-3512: a Kafka target's audience needs a stronger privacy grade than the run has

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A Kafka target declares who reads it. An internal audience works for the data's owner and needs a run graded P1 (checked) or better; an external audience does not, and needs P3 (differentially private marginals) or better. Grades compare in ADR 0020's order, P5 &lt; P1 &lt; P3 &lt; P4 &lt; P0, so P3, P4 and P0 reach an external audience and P5 reaches neither. The sink is also refused when it was not given the run's grade, or was given one that is not a grade. The message names the stream, the grade, the audience and the minimum, never a value of the data. Pin a profile released under differential privacy to reach an external audience, or deliver to an internal target. Nothing was written, and nothing was contacted.
